_about: The breast as a volume over the chest (Rafael, 2026-11-09), by eye, edit to change. Each shape is that volume's outline: base_cm the radius of its base at a neutral cup, upper and lower how far the base reaches up and down as shares of it, power how the front closes: 2 is round, lower is more pointed, higher fuller at the front. Its projection comes from bust minus underbust.
